entries.title: Proverbs 1:1
segments: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:2
segments: To know wisdom and instruction; To discern the words of understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:3
segments: To receive instruction in wise dealing, In righteousness and justice and equity;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:4
segments: To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:5
segments: That the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; And that the man of understanding may attain unto sound counsels:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:6
segments: To understand a proverb, and a figure, The words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:7
segments: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; [But] the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:8
segments: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, And forsake not the law of thy mother:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:9
segments: For they shall be a chaplet of grace unto thy head, And chains about thy neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:10
segments: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:11
segments: If they say, Come with us, Let us lay wait for blood; Let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:12
segments: Let us swallow them up alive as Sheol, And whole, as those that go down into the pit;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:13
segments: We shall find all precious substance; We shall fill our houses with spoil;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:14
segments: Thou shalt cast thy lot among us; We will all have one purse:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:15
segments: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:16
segments: For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:17
segments: For in vain is the net spread In the sight of any bird:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:18
segments: And these lay wait for their own blood; They lurk privily for their own lives.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:19
segments: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; It taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:20
segments: Wisdom crieth aloud in the street; She uttereth her voice in the broad places;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:21
segments: She crieth in the chief place of concourse; At the entrance of the gates, In the city, she uttereth her words:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:22
segments: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And scoffers delight them in scoffing, And fools hate knowledge?

entries.title: Proverbs 1:23
segments: Turn you at my reproof: Behold, I will pour out my spirit upon you; I will make known my words unto you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:24
segments: Because I have called, and ye have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man hath regarded;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:25
segments: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, And would none of my reproof:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:26
segments: I also will laugh in [the day of] your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:27
segments: When your fear cometh as a storm, And your calamity cometh on as a whirlwind; When distress and anguish come upon you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:28
segments: Then will they call upon me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they shall not find me:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:29
segments: For that they hated knowledge, And did not choose the fear of Jehovah:

entries.title: Proverbs 1:30
segments: They would none of my counsel; They despised all my reproof.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:31
segments: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, And be filled with their own devices.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:32
segments: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them, And the careless ease of fools shall destroy them.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:33
segments: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell securely, And shall be quiet without fear of evil.
